about_the_game:
CrimeBloc

Free-to-Play Text-Based Crime MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc

Step into the shadows of the post-Soviet underworld. CrimeBloc is a gritty text-driven MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Eastern Bloc. For over 18 years, thousands of players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency.

Build Your Empire. Enforce Your Will. Eliminate Your Enemies.

  • Classic Text-Based Gameplay with Depth

Experience the strategic richness of text-based gaming. Every action matters. Your rise to power depends on smart decisions, alliances, and ruthless efficiency.

  • Persistent Online World

Join an active, player-driven underworld where crime families form and fall, cities are contested, and operations span days or weeks. Every choice shapes your legacy.

  • Extensive Criminal Activities

Steal rare cars, rob banks, commit heists, or take out your rivals. With dozens of criminal options, from small street hustles to major operations! There are many paths to domination.

  • Player vs Player Combat

Challenge other players to fights, assassinate enemies, or raid their assets. Warfare in CrimeBloc is strategic, brutal, and unforgiving.

  • Deep Progression System

Train your stats, upgrade equipment, acquire properties, and unlock high-level crimes. Build a unique character to suit your criminal style.

  • Operate Across Eastern Bloc Cities

From Moscow to Odessa, each city presents different risks and opportunities. Control them, exploit them, or burn them to the ground.

  • Player-Run Casinos and Gambling

Test your luck! CrimeBloc features player-owned casinos where you can wager your in-game cash on games like slots, roulette, blackjack, video poker, and more. Become a high roller, or invest in your own casino to profit from other players' risk. Gambling is fully integrated into the economy and offers both entertainment and strategic opportunities.

  • 100% Free to Play

CrimeBloc is free to play and always has been. Success is earned through strategy, persistence, and street smarts.

Whether you are a veteran of old-school browser games or a newcomer seeking something different, CrimeBloc offers a deep and uncompromising look into the digital criminal underworld. Form alliances, betray partners, and climb to the top! if you can survive the climb.

The Bloc is waiting. Do you have what it takes?
